<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_RoboticBurgerSeller"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/robotic-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuQuestion" name="Menu question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MenuChoice" name="Menu choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SideQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges choice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Burger status update"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoboticBurgerSeller">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Robot" name="Robotic burger seller" processRef="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuQuestion" name="Menu question" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MenuChoice" name="Menu choice" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideQuestion" name="Fries or wedges question" sourceRef="Task_AskSide" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges choice" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Status update" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoboticBurgerSeller" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Robot">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Robot" name="Robot">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_OrderReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskMenu</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveMenuChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MenuChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MenuParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareDrink</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskSide</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveSideChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SideChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFries</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareWedges</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SideMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MenuParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MenuMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareBurger</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_StatusUpdateSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderDelivered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskMenu" name="Ask whether the customer wants a menu or just the burger" messageRef="Message_MenuQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" name="Receive menu choice" messageRef="Message_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice" name="Menu or just burger?"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" name="Prepare menu items in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskSide" name="Ask whether the customer wants fries or wedges" messageRef="Message_SideQuestion"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" name="Receive fries or wedges choice" messageRef="Message_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideChoice" name="Fries or wedges?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the fries order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the size of the wedges order.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SideMerge" name="Merge side preparation alternatives"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin" name="Drink and side ready"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuMerge" name="Continue to burger preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Preparation duration varies depending on the number of ingredients. Enthusiastic status updates are given every 30 seconds while preparing the burger.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_StatusTimer">
        <bpmn:timeCycle>R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdateSent" name="Status update sent"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderToAskMenu" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_AskMenu"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskMenuToReceiveChoice" sourceRef="Task_AskMenu" targetRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveChoiceToMenuGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveMenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoiceToMenu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer selects menu</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuChoiceToBurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice" targetRef="Gateway_MenuMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer selects just the burger</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuSplitToAskSide" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AskSide"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskSideToReceiveChoice" sourceRef="Task_AskSide" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSideChoiceToGateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSideChoice" targetRef="Gateway_SideChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideChoiceToFries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer selects fries</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideChoiceToWedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_SideChoice" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Customer selects wedges</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriesToSideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WedgesToSideMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_SideMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SideMergeToMenuJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_SideMerge" targetRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuJoinToMenuMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuParallelJoin" targetRef="Gateway_MenuMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MenuMergeToBurger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuMerge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerToDelivery" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerToStatusUpdate" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_StatusTimer" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusUpdateToEnd" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdateSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryToEnd" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
